scope: LOCAL ONLY — no commit, no push, no deploy (evidence inspection precedes governed release)
objective: ENTERPRISE PILOT ONBOARDING READY via a minimal governed onboarding control; no fake enrollment, no forced-green badges
existing_controls_reused: governance/remote_challenge_response.validate_challenge_response (challenge expiry, single-use nonce, device/policy binding, replay rejection)
governance/continuous_trust_renewal (renewal chain — surfaced via existing snapshots)
policy_runtime_state / replay_protection_active (policy registry validity, replay guard)
env-driven trust registry pattern (USBAY_* CSV/JSON envs) used by all device-trust controls
architecture_map: CUSTOMER -> HUMAN APPROVAL (USBAY_PILOT_HUMAN_APPROVAL_JSON; approver_kind must be human; AI self-approval rejected) -> ENTERPRISE IDENTITY (pilot contract USBAY_PILOT_CONTRACT_JSON: pilot/tenant/environment/device/verifier/approval-ref/policy-ref/issued/expires/status) -> DEVICE+VERIFIER ENROLLMENT (fingerprints must exist in USBAY_ENROLLED_DEVICE_FINGERPRINTS / USBAY_ENROLLED_VERIFIER_IDS or verifier key registry) -> CHALLENGE+ATTESTATION (existing Ed25519 challenge validator: expiry, single-use, device-bound, policy-bound) -> POLICY (registry valid + contract policy_reference match) -> ENFORCEMENT GATE (enterprise_execution_gate: all-or-nothing) -> EXECUTION or BLOCK -> AUDIT EVIDENCE (hashes/references only)
state_machine: NOT_ENROLLED -> PENDING_HUMAN_APPROVAL -> ENROLLED -> CHALLENGE_REQUIRED -> ATTESTATION_VERIFIED -> VERIFIED; all failures -> BLOCKED (invalid signature, expired challenge, replayed nonce, unknown device, unknown verifier, revoked, suspended, expired enrollment, missing human approval, tenant/environment/device/verifier mismatch); no silent recovery; no authority from PENDING

readiness_separation.PLATFORM_READY: policy registry valid AND runtime NORMAL AND replay protection active AND evidence chain valid AND production sync match
readiness_separation.PILOT_ONBOARDING_READY: platform ready AND onboarding mechanism live AND fail-closed suite green (release-gated)
readiness_separation.PILOT_ENROLLED: real contract + human approval + device/verifier enrollment + attestation (fixture-proof only in tests; live state: NOT enrolled)
readiness_separation.PILOT_RUNTIME_READY: enrolled AND verified AND attestation AND policy AND sync AND evidence
readiness_separation.FULL_PRODUCTION_READY: never derived true by this control

execution_gate: execution_authorized=true ONLY when enrollment_state=VERIFIED AND human approval valid AND device+verifier enrolled AND challenge/attestation valid AND policy valid AND policy_reference matches AND commit_match=match AND evidence chain valid; otherwise execution_authorized=false with reason_code; no partial success
surface: GET /api/governance/pilot-onboarding (non-sensitive JSON: enrollment state, readiness states, gate dry-run, commit_match); existing dashboard badges intentionally unchanged (PILOT · DEGRADED, VERIFIER NOT ENROLLED remain truthful)
tests: 70/70 PASS — 30 pilot-onboarding unit (15-item negative matrix incl. AI self-approval, wrong tenant/environment/device/verifier, revoked/suspended/expired, replay, sync-drift gate, evidence gate; state-machine progression; readiness separation; evidence hygiene; canonical-status and finite-lifetime hardening) + 6 endpoint/snapshot integration (env-backed valid enrollment authorizes; policy version label rejected — immutable policy hash only; malformed contract/approval JSON fail closed; approval-reference redaction) + 12 drift-truth + 6 boot readiness + 16 execution guard
evidence_hygiene: pilot/tenant/environment IDs and the human approval reference recorded as SHA-256 hashes only; device/verifier as hash references; approval decision recorded; no private keys, tokens, PATs, raw nonces, PEM material, or raw approval references (test-asserted at module and endpoint level)
remaining_gaps: Live enrollment requires a real customer: human approval record, real device identity packet, verifier enrollment — intentionally absent.

This control is not yet wired as a mandatory block inside the general /execute pipeline; it gates via enterprise_execution_gate and its API surface. Wiring into /execute for pilot-context requests is deferred to the enrollment release to avoid changing existing authorization semantics (forbidden this batch).
Changes are local-only; governed release requires human approval.

GET /api/governance/pilot-onboarding is unauthenticated (like the existing governance status surfaces); it now discloses only hashes/state, but endpoint authentication is a candidate hardening before real customer enrollment.
independent_review: Architect review round flagged: identity fingerprint read from wrong key (live enrollment could never authorize), case-normalized status acceptance, non-finite expiry acceptance, policy version-or-hash leniency, runtime self-attestation of the fail-closed suite, and raw approval-reference disclosure on the unauthenticated endpoint. All six remediated: fingerprint sourced from identity audit evidence; exact canonical status enum; finite timestamps required; policy pin is immutable hash only; readiness reports failclosed_suite=release_gated instead of self-attesting; approval reference exposed only as SHA-256 hash (test-asserted).
